Hi Sarah —

Thanks again for the demo last week. Per our discussion I attached a concise mutual action plan (MAP) that reflects the evaluation milestones you called out and a target close date of 2026-03-12. Key items included:

- Sandbox access + sample dataset loaded (7 days)
- Perf/latency tests & quantization guidance (10 days)

If the MAP looks right, I'd like to lock the close target and coordinate a weekly checkpoint call (30 minutes) starting next Tuesday.

Hi Marissa —

Appreciate the clear plan and the MAP. Two quick updates from our side:

1) Procurement needs an updated SOW and estimated unit cost line items before legal will accept the commercial deck. That typically adds ~7 business days.
2) Our security team requested a short additional review of your SOC 2 evidence and an RSA configuration note — that might add another 3–5 business days depending on availability.

I want to be transparent: at this point the March 12 close is optimistic; my internal projection is slipping toward late March / early April unless procurement and security can be parallelized.

Can you confirm whether we can: (a) provide an updated SOW this week, and (b) schedule the security handoff call with your CISO/Risk contact?
